summary: Import-time dropper fetches and executes platform-specific binary from anonymous Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: The package advertises itself as a React UI component library but ships no React code. On require(), index.js loads setup.js which selects a platform-specific asset path (/pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe) based on os.platform()/os.arch() and passes it to lib/telemetry.js runtime.run(). The runtime downloads bytes over HTTPS from a rotating set of anonymous Cloudflare Workers subdomains (oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, cf100-416, cf101-adf, cf102-baf, cf103-070) with a *.dl.well1.site DNS fallback, base64-decodes the payload into a Buffer, writes it to disk, chmod 0o755, and executes it. Network hostnames, sensitive API names (os.platform, os.hostname, fs.chmodSync), and the child_process module name are reconstructed at runtime from split string fragments joined with '+' to defeat signature-based scanning. setup.js additionally computes an install fingerprint from os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), process.version, and process.pid (sha256, first 16 hex) and sends it as installId to the same hardcoded endpoints, identifying the installer host and user. The destinations are not caller-configurable, the fetched binary is unpinned and unverified, and the delivery path fires automatically on module load.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
